name: AXIS-Y Dark Spot Correcting Glow Serum | Korean Brightening Serum with 5% Niacinamide & Squalane | Helps Reduce Dark Spots & Acne Marks | 50ml
description:
Achieve a brighter, smoother, and more even-looking complexion with AXIS-Y Dark Spot Correcting Glow Serum. This lightweight, gel-based Korean serum is specially formulated to help improve the appearance of hyperpigmentation, acne scars, and uneven skin tone while keeping the skin hydrated and calm. Enriched with 5% Niacinamide, Squalane, Papaya, Sea Buckthorn, and Rice Bran extracts, it delivers deep nourishment and a healthy glow without leaving a greasy residue.

Key Features
Enriched with 5% Niacinamide and Squalane
Helps reduce the appearance of dark spots and acne scars
Supports a brighter and more even-looking skin tone
Helps refine pores and improve skin texture
Deeply hydrates without feeling greasy
Papaya and Sea Buckthorn help brighten and repair the skin
Rice Bran helps smooth and enhance radiance
Lightweight, fast-absorbing gel formula
Helps keep the skin calm and refreshed
Suitable for all skin types

Product Specifications
Product Type: Brightening Face Serum
Volume: 50ml
Texture: Lightweight Gel Serum
Skin Type: All Skin Types
Usage: Face
Origin: Korea

How to Use
Apply 1–2 pumps after cleansing and toning
Spread evenly across the face or apply to specific spots
Gently pat until fully absorbed
Follow with a moisturizer
For morning use, always apply sunscreen afterward

Material / Composition
5% Niacinamide
Squalane
Papaya Extract
Sea Buckthorn Extract
Rice Bran Extract
Hydrating and skin-conditioning ingredients

Safety Information
For external use only
Avoid contact with eyes
Perform a patch test before first use
Discontinue use if irritation occurs
Keep out of reach of children
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
